description: The picture of the touch screen's action button for the map event in reach of the player. states: the in-game state an event runs (config names of sh::game_state, as in main_frame.json) -> act, take, read, open, use or check. handlers: rules over the name of the map handler an EventCallback event runs (maps/<map>/handlers.json), '*' for any run of letters; the first rule that matches wins over the state. An event no rule names shows the plain action button. A mod changes it with a file of the same path in its own folder.
